rrvarma style, ok so i dont really remember the story, its from an old picture my grandmother kept in her pooja room. there is an old king, very tired and sad, lying on the floor of a dark room in his pallace, his crown fallen off and lying next to him. his young wife is sitting on a low bed a little way off with her back half turned to him, still angry, and her jewelery is thrown all over the floor around her. there is only one small lamp burning so most of the room is in shadow. i think he was begging her to change her mind about something and she wouldnt listen. can you make it look like that, quiet and sad, oil painting, canvas texture, classical indian art
